UXUC81C is a specific medical procedure code used in the Danish healthcare system to identify transesophageal echocardiography with contrast [^src1]. It serves as a critical data point for tracking and measuring the quality of diagnostic practices for patients with [[atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) [^src1]. 

Within the national quality indicators for atrial fibrillation, UXUC81C is grouped under the broader clinical indicator area for [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] (echocardiography) [^src3]. Specifically, the echocardiography indicator area relies on a defined set of procedure codes to capture comprehensive diagnostic imaging data: [[uxuc80c|UXUC80C]], [[uxuc80d|UXUC80D]], [[uxuc80e|UXUC80E]], [[uxuc81|UXUC81]], and UXUC81C [^src1]. 

These codes are utilized in the Danish Health Registry (Sygesikringsregisteret) to standardize data collection, calculate denominators and numerators for quality metrics, and ensure evidence-based clinical standards are met across regions [^src2]. The consistent documentation of UXUC81C across consecutive annual reports from 2023 to 2025 highlights its ongoing, stable role in monitoring diagnostic quality and guiding cardiovascular care improvements nationwide [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].
